name: print-social-business-posts-with-orange-diamond-photo-frames-and-serif
title: Pale business pack with circle portraits inside orange diamonds, stair motifs and condensed serif
whatItIs: Five pale grey-green square posts: circular black-and-white portraits set inside orange rotated squares, small mustard staircase shapes, half-circles and dot rows, and tall condensed serif headlines in teal ('See The World With Business.', 'Grow Your Business').
whatItMeans: Refined and optimistic; geometry and the stair motif signal growth without clichéd charts.
techniques: Nest a circle photo in a rotated square.
Use a small staircase shape as a growth symbol.
Pair a condensed serif with sparse geometric confetti.
Keep photos greyscale so one accent colour dominates.

vocabulary.definition: A square turned 45° into a diamond.
A narrow serif typeface for tall headlines.
